description:
The returned data and pagination size depend on the Adapter.Api.Controller.rest.v2.Issuing.Read.ViewTypes.IssuingSummaryViewType specified
            in issuingRequest. If the view is set to Adapter.Api.Controller.rest.v2.Issuing.Read.ViewTypes.IssuingSummaryViewType.Id, up to 5000 records
            are returned; otherwise, the maximum page size is 100.

parameters.name: filters[columns]
parameters.description: Optional columns to include in the query filter.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of unique identifiers (UUIDs) to filter.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of issue statuses to filter (values match Core.Models.Issuing.DirectIssueStatus serialization, e.g. STARTED).

parameters.name: filters[state]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of document states to filter (values match Core.Models.Documents.DocumentState.StateType serialization).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field. Prefix with '-' for descending order (e.g. '-created_at').

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
